properties.project_name: P24 -- waterfront lawn (Bayfront Park approach, south of 499 Illinois St)
properties.digitized_from: Real-gap-fragment technique: bbox.difference(street buffer).difference(already-tracked polygons) around the 499 Illinois St / Bayfront Park area (fragment 2, 19,181.78 sqm raw). The owner reviewed a 3-way width-scan split of that fragment (at its two real cross-sectional waists, lat 37.7658 and 37.76665) and then directed the same fork-cut technique used for P26: keep the wide single-segment 'head', drop the thin multi-segment 'horns'.
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-20: the owner corrected the prior resolution (which had P24 'landing exactly inside the already-tracked real footprint of 499 Illinois Street / Alexandria Center, not a separate undeveloped parcel'). Re-derived via the numbered real-gap-fragment technique: fragment 2 (19,181.78 sqm) was first split into 3 pieces at real cross-sectional width-scan waists (piece0 south lawn, piece1 middle plaza, piece2 north lawn). P24 = piece0 (the south lawn, 7,464 sqm), then cut with the same nseg-based fork technique as P26: a width-cross-section scan found the cross-section splits from a single segment into 2-3 separate segments at lat 37.76562 (the point where the 499 Illinois St building's stepped corner intrudes from the north), matching a 'head with two horns' shape -- kept only the single-segment head south of that latitude (6,616 sqm, the clean triangular Bayfront-Park-style lawn with its curved path) and dropped both thin sidewalk-hugging horns above it (848 sqm total, hugging the UCSF parking structure to the west and 499 Illinois St to the east). 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: sources for the parcel label and status are now listed in source_doc_urls (OCII Dec 2019 Land Use Map labels P24; OCII Sept 2023 transition deck lists P24 among parcels the Port will manage, not among 'when built' parcels). The lawn, path and trees are an imagery observation with no document cited.
properties.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- landscaped open land (lawn, curved path, scattered trees) as seen in Esri satellite imagery (an imagery observation; no document cited) and the street/already-tracked-polygon-bounded gap computation, cut at an owner-directed cross-sectional fork point rather than a surveyed parcel boundary. Name and operator not confirmed by any source found in this pass; a hedged observation from imagery (no source cited) that it visually resembles Bayfront Park's own style and may be a continuation of it.
properties.notes: OCII plan open-space parcel P24 (the label appears on OCII's December 2019 Mission Bay Land Use Map). Triangular waterfront lawn south of 499 Illinois St, along Terry Francois Blvd, adjoining the Bayfront Park path (location from this project's own tracing).
